info.name: Fengle Backend API
info.description: Fengle backend API — all four clients (Customer App, Restaurant, Rider, Admin) share this one API under /api/v1. JWT bearer auth via OTP (admin: email+password). Test scripts on OTP-verify/create endpoints auto-capture tokens and IDs into collection variables. See docs/API.md for the full field-level reference.

variable.description: Replace with the code printed to the server console as `[dev-sms] OTP for <phone>: <code>`
A second category id, used for clubbing/lock scenarios

request.description: Dev only (not mounted in production). Returns the last OTP requested for this phone since the server started.
Dev only. Body {"to":"delivered"} runs to that step. Drives the real restaurant/rider handlers.
Dev only. The customer must have logged in once.
purpose: login | signup | restaurant_login | rider_login. In dev, watch the server console for `[dev-sms] OTP for <phone>: <code>` and put it in the otp_code variable.
First-time verify auto-creates the customer account. Saves the returned token into {{customer_token}}.
Returns 404 if this phone has not already been onboarded by admin (Restaurants > Onboard Restaurant) — no restaurant self-signup exists.
First-time verify auto-creates the rider account (riders are self-serve, unlike restaurants). Saves the returned token into {{rider_token}}.

No signup endpoint — bootstrap the first account with `node scripts/create-admin.js "Name" "email@example.com" "password" super_admin`, then log in here. Saves the returned token into {{admin_token}}.
Call on app boot — 200 means skip Splash/Onboarding/Phone/OTP; 401 means log in again.
JWTs are stateless; this just deregisters the push token if sent. Client discards its token.
lat/lng are required — response is location-filtered, never a flat catalog.
Use admin_token, or restaurant_token if the restaurant is approved for this category.
restaurant_token's id must equal :restaurantId (403 otherwise).
Category header + Popular/More sections. lat/lng required.
Cross-category Popular picks for Home.
Add an item from a second category to the items array to test club vs lock: clubbable:true = same kitchen (Club sheet), clubbable:false = Lock sheet. Never reveals the restaurant.
Order must have been placed with payment_method 'upi'. Idempotent.
Order must have been placed with payment_method 'card'. Dev stub auto-succeeds; 501 once real Razorpay keys are set.
The only way a restaurant enters the system — no self-registration endpoint exists.

payment_method: upi | card | netbanking | cod | wallet. Max 2 categories per cart. Min order value ₹50. Response includes cgst_amount/sgst_amount (2.5%+2.5% of item_total, folded into grand_total). payment_method 'wallet' debits the customer's balance in full immediately (402 if insufficient).
Only relevant for non-COD orders. Razorpay is stubbed in dev — signature verification auto-succeeds.
409 once the restaurant has called start-preparing.
Pass item ids to drop for partial unavailability — bill is adjusted and the difference refunded to wallet if already paid.
Auto-cascades to the next candidate restaurant, or cancels + refunds if none remain.
Closes the cancellation window. Only valid from status 'accepted'.
Sets a one-time ETA estimate that does not continuously update.

cod_amount_collected is required for COD orders and MUST exactly match the order's grand_total — check GET /orders/:id first and set this value accordingly. Omit the field entirely for non-COD orders.
Swap the bearer token to restaurant_token or rider_token to see that role's orders instead.
404 until a rider is assigned. Returns the real rider phone for now (no masking yet).
Only after delivery.
Only after delivery. Clears the rating gate on POST /orders.
Clears the rating gate without rating; still rateable later.
Use Send and Download in Postman to save the PDF.
Re-runs the full place-order pipeline with the original items at current prices. Body fields are optional (falls back to the default address + original payment method).
The first address saved always becomes the default regardless of is_default. Returns the full updated list.
If this was the default, the most-recently-added remaining address (if any) becomes the new default.
Swap the bearer token to rider_token to see the rider's COD-liability/earnings ledger instead.
Fills in name/vehicle collected in the onboarding step after OTP signup. Any of name, vehicle_type (bike|scooter|bicycle|car), vehicle_number (null clears it).
Foreground-only ping — no background GPS tracking in Phase 1.
No scheduled job exists — this is the only way settlement runs today. Get rider_id_to_settle from GET /admin/riders.
Profile + approved categories.
Every active item in approved categories with is_available. Toggle via PATCH availability (Catalog folder).
Only from accepted. Idempotent. Signal for the rider; does not change status.
multipart/form-data, one file field named image (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 2 MB). Returns { url } — saved to {{uploaded_image_url}} to use as image_url in POST /items.
Any of name, price, is_veg, image_url (null removes the photo), description. category_id cannot change. Restaurants can edit any item in a category they carry, incl. admin-seeded (shared item).
All active categories (joined flag) + exact and similar matches for q. exact/similar only when q is non-empty.
409 category_exists (never created), 409 similar_categories (resend with confirm_not_duplicate:true), 400 invalid_name, 403 category_limit, 201 { category }.
Join an existing category. 409 already_joined, 404 unknown/inactive.
